population: Unselected (anti-Ro/SSA positive in the remibrutinib trial)
note: No Sjogren-specific animal model was found for any member: remibrutinib (positive phase 2) and BMS-986142 (trial terminated) went in on arthritis models and occupancy, tirabrutinib (failed phase 2) on a human PK/PD model.
label: Sjogren syndrome (BTK inhibitors)

engagement.population: Healthy volunteers (remibrutinib single and multiple ascending dose)
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (J Med Chem paywalled). FDA integrated review (NDA 218436) describes the rat spleen/blood occupancy studies.
engagement.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
engagement.note: Remibrutinib reached an occupancy EC90 of 1.6 mg/kg in rats; no human occupancy data yet.
engagement.quote: It demonstrates potent in vivo target occupancy with an EC90 of 1.6 mg/kg and dose-dependent efficacy in rat collagen-induced arthritis.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry at first public use of the rat occupancy system.

engagement.magnitude_basis: blood BTK occupancy, rat vs healthy volunteers
engagement.population: Healthy volunteers (remibrutinib single and multiple ascending dose)
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC8504815); the paper does not itself compare with rat data. Ibrutinib had shown full BTK occupancy in patients in 2012 (Advani 2013, PMID 23045577); the engagement retrodiction rule counts another drug's result for the same target and action.
engagement.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
engagement.note: Healthy volunteers: blood BTK occupancy >95% for 24 h at single doses of at least 30 mg, as in rat blood and spleen. Retrodiction: the rat occupancy work (2020) was public after ibrutinib's patient BTK occupancy (2012), so a reproduction of a known target result.
engagement.quote: With remibrutinib doses greater than or equal to 30 mg, blood BTK occupancy was greater than 95% for at least 24 h (SAD).
engagement.judgement: Paired by me: the readout the rat system used (BTK occupancy) moved in dosed humans; direction-only match because rat and human dose scales differ. Re-scored retro under the retrodiction ruling: BTK occupancy was already known to move in dosed humans.

engagement.note: BMS-986142 blocked BCR-driven B-cell activation and was efficacious in mouse CIA/CAIA without complete BTK inhibition.
engagement.quote: In both models, robust efficacy was observed without continuous, complete inhibition of BTK.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry for the BMS-986142 system; the paper names primary Sjogren's syndrome as a clinical indication.

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level for both papers; whether the mouse work itself read out CD69 ex vivo was not confirmed (the abstract reports co-stimulatory molecule blockade in human B cells). Lee 2017 epub 2017-03-06 precedes Gillooly 2017 epub 2017-07-24. Ibrutinib had shown full BTK occupancy in patients in 2012 (Advani 2013, PMID 23045577).
engagement.note: Healthy volunteers: dose-dependent inhibition of CD69, the B-cell activation readout the model blocked. Retrodiction: the mouse paper (July 2017) was public after this human result (March 2017) and after ibrutinib's patient occupancy (2012).
engagement.quote: A dose- and concentration-dependent inhibition of CD69 expression was observed following administration of BMS-986142.
engagement.judgement: Judgement call: matched the model's BCR-activation readout (co-stimulatory molecule/CD69 expression) to the human ex-vivo CD69 assay; scored direct as ex-vivo blockade of a stimulus. Paired by me. Re-scored retro under the retrodiction ruling (model first public after the human engagement result).

dose.population: Healthy volunteers (remibrutinib single and multiple ascending dose)
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level; the abstract states an occupancy EC90, not a human dose.
dose.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
dose.note: Rat occupancy work set near-complete (EC90) BTK occupancy as the exposure target; no human data yet.
dose.quote: It demonstrates potent in vivo target occupancy with an EC90 of 1.6 mg/kg and dose-dependent efficacy in rat collagen-induced arthritis.
dose.judgement: Read the EC90 as the model's stated occupancy target.

dose.magnitude_basis: blood BTK occupancy vs rat EC90
dose.population: Healthy volunteers (remibrutinib single and multiple ascending dose)
dose.confidence_note: Full text read. The rat/dog NOAEL margins (12-77x at 25 mg BID) were public only in the 2025 FDA review and were computed for the CSU dose, so no margin is scored.
dose.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
dose.note: Near-complete blood BTK occupancy was reached at 10 mg once daily and above; the Sjogren trial used 100 mg once or twice daily.
dose.quote: With MAD, remibrutinib reached near complete blood BTK occupancy at day 12 predose with greater than or equal to 10 mg q.d.
dose.reason: Rat occupancy target reached in humans
dose.judgement: Judgement call: the target is the rat system's occupancy EC90, reached in healthy volunteers; margin_stated false because no margin for the Sjogren doses was public before the trial.

dose.population: Active Sjogren syndrome, ESSDAI >= 5 (tirabrutinib 40 mg arm); model fit to healthy-volunteer and RA occupancy data
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Model built on human data, not an animal; published after the Sjogren trial (NCT03100942) had posted results.
dose.note: Model on healthy-volunteer and RA occupancy data supported at least 40 mg/day for >90% occupancy; the Sjogren trial used 40 mg but reported no occupancy.
dose.quote: Overall, the model-based simulation supported a total daily dose of at least 40 mg, either q.d. or b.i.d., with adequate BTK occupancy (> 90%) for further development in inflammatory diseases.
dose.judgement: Judgement call: the target was fit to the same human data it would be checked against, and Price 2022 reports no BTK occupancy in Sjogren patients, so untested (not_measured).

efficacy.confidence_note: Registry NCT02843659 results posted 2018-10-04: 18 randomized (6 on BMS-986142), none completed; terminated for inability to meet protocol objectives.
efficacy.note: BMS-986142 Sjogren trial (NCT02843659) terminated after 6 patients on drug; no efficacy comparison possible.
efficacy.quote: BMS-986142 is a potent and highly selective reversible small molecule inhibitor of BTK currently being investigated in clinical trials for the treatment of both RA and primary Sjögren's syndrome.
efficacy.judgement: Model is an RA (arthritis) model relied on for a Sjogren entry; the Sjogren trial gave no interpretable ESSDAI result.

patient_trials.quote: The study was terminated and the remaining 15 randomized subjects who had not yet completed the double-blind period entered the follow-up period.

efficacy.population: Sjogren syndrome, anti-Ro/SSA positive, ESSDAI >= 5 and ESSPRI >= 5 (LOUiSSe, remibrutinib)
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level. No Sjogren-specific animal model was found for any member; the trial paper argues from mechanism.
efficacy.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
efficacy.note: Remibrutinib was dose-dependently efficacious in rat collagen-induced arthritis, cited alongside its Sjogren phase 2.
efficacy.quote: It demonstrates potent in vivo target occupancy with an EC90 of 1.6 mg/kg and dose-dependent efficacy in rat collagen-induced arthritis.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry: an arthritis model is the only disease model found in the remibrutinib Sjogren rationale.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: week-12 composite responder rate in tirabrutinib's Sjogren trial, 34.7% vs placebo 26.7% (P=0.33)
efficacy.population: Sjogren syndrome, anti-Ro/SSA positive, ESSDAI >= 5 and ESSPRI >= 5 (LOUiSSe, remibrutinib)
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read for the trial; the model side is a rat arthritis model (cross-disease), abstract-level. Year from registry results posting (2022-12-20).
efficacy.model: Rat BTK occupancy and collagen-induced arthritis (remibrutinib)
efficacy.note: Ruling: Angst 2020 (public February 2020) came out after tirabrutinib's failed Sjogren result (registry results 2020-01-22), so it is a retrodiction scored against that result. Its rat arthritis efficacy predicts benefit from BTK inhibition and does not reproduce the tirabrutinib failure, so the track is contra from 2020. LOUiSSe later met its primary (remibrutinib ESSDAI -2.86 vs placebo, p=0.003, results 2022-12-20); a failed model stays failed on its track, so this does not turn it back.
efficacy.quote: Remibrutinib significantly improved ESSDAI score in patients with SjS over 24 weeks compared with placebo (ΔESSDAI -2.86, p=0.003).
efficacy.reason: Retrodiction did not reproduce the known tirabrutinib failure
efficacy.judgement: Ruled: the rat CIA efficacy is a retrodiction because it post-dates tirabrutinib's failed Sjogren trial on the same target; scored contra against that failure. LOUiSSe's later success is recorded in the note, not scored.

patient_trials.quote: At week 12, 43.3% of the filgotinib group achieved the primary end point (P = 0.17 vs placebo) vs 42.3% (P = 0.16), 34.7% (P = 0.33), and 26.7% of lanraplenib, tirabrutinib, and placebo groups, respectively.

efficacy.model: Mouse collagen-induced arthritis (DBA/1J) dosed with tirabrutinib (ONO-4059)
efficacy.note: Ono's mouse CIA study: oral ONO-4059 dose-dependently reduced arthritis score and bone damage; no Sjogren model reported for tirabrutinib.
efficacy.quote: Treatment with ONO-4059 resulted in a dose-dependent inhibition of arthritis severity and bone damage in the CIA model.
efficacy.confidence_note: ACR 2012 meeting abstract (Arthritis Rheum supplement), no DOI or PMID; used only to date the model's first use.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry dated to the first public CIA data for this drug, before the 2017 Sjogren trial start.
efficacy.population: Unselected (active primary or secondary Sjogren syndrome, ESSDAI >= 5)

efficacy.model: Mouse collagen-induced arthritis (DBA/1J) dosed with tirabrutinib (ONO-4059)
efficacy.note: Mouse CIA efficacy led Ono to call for clinical testing in inflammatory disease; tirabrutinib 40 mg missed the week-12 composite primary in Sjogren (34.7% vs 26.7%, P=0.33).
efficacy.quote: Three drugs with disparate mechanisms were tested, but no significant differences vs placebo in primary or secondary end points were observed.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Model side (Ariza 2019, J Mol Sci, iMedPub) has no DOI or PMID, so tier 1 for model_src is contested; cross-disease model (RA arthritis model for a Sjogren trial).
efficacy.judgement: Paired by me: CIA efficacy (predicting benefit) vs the NCT03100942 primary. Year is the registry results posting (2020-01-22). Contra, not untested: the 40 mg arm was dosed and completed, so the miss is efficacy.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: week-12 composite responder rate, tirabrutinib 34.7% vs placebo 26.7% (P=0.33)
efficacy.population: Unselected (active primary or secondary Sjogren syndrome, ESSDAI >= 5)

safety.population: Sjogren syndrome, anti-Ro/SSA positive, ESSDAI >= 5 and ESSPRI >= 5 (LOUiSSe, remibrutinib)
safety.confidence_note: 2016 is a proxy for the first 2-week GLP studies; the toxicology was unpublished until the NDA 218436 review.
safety.note: Rat and dog studies showed prolonged bleeding time and inhibited platelet aggregation; data not public until the 2025 FDA review.
safety.short: Bleeding signal in rat and dog
safety.quote: Inhibition of collagen-induced platelet aggregation and prolonged bleeding time were observed in both rat and dog toxicology studies.

safety.magnitude_basis: bleeding adverse-event rate, remibrutinib 10.2% vs placebo 8.3% over 24 weeks in Sjogren
safety.population: Sjogren syndrome, anti-Ro/SSA positive, ESSDAI >= 5 and ESSPRI >= 5 (LOUiSSe, remibrutinib)
safety.confidence_note: Dörner 2024 full text read (PMC10894844); small trial (49 on drug, 24 on placebo), bleeding numerically higher. Toxicology read in the bundled NDA 218436 integrated review; rat-specific pancreatic islet fibrosis not scored. Year is the first public date of the model side (2025).
safety.note: Sjogren patients were measured, so their result sets the status, not CSU (9% vs 2% bleeding on the label, now context only). Bleeding was comparable to placebo (10.2% vs 8.3%). The rat/dog toxicology was first public in 2025, after this result, so it is a retrodiction that did not reproduce it.
safety.quote: Minor mild-to-moderate non-serious bleeding events were reported at comparable frequencies between the remibrutinib arms (10.2%) and placebo arm (8.3%).
safety.reason: Predicted bleeding not above placebo in Sjogren
safety.judgement: Imported-harm ruling: CSU data set aside because Sjogren patients were measured. Safety retrodiction ruling: the same drug's Sjogren result (registry 2022-12-20) was public before the toxicology (2025); the predicted bleeding did not exceed placebo, so contra rather than retro.
